mine: a beautiful headdress instead of ashes
note: Hebrew pe'er is a turban or headdress (cf. v. 10), a wordplay with 'epher "ashes": the mourner's ashes on the head are replaced by a festive head-covering.

kjv: I hate robbery for burnt offering
note: The consonants b'wlh can be vocalised be'olah "for burnt offering" (MT, KJV) or be'awlah "with injustice" (LXX, Targum, many modern versions), which fits the context of justice.
